children: Mechanics Bancorp completed sale of approximately $417 million of remaining performing indirect auto loans to Bank of America, retaining about $13 million.
Mechanics Bank sold ~ $417 million of performing indirect auto loans to Bank of America’s trading desk at a price near book value.
The transaction had a cutoff date of August 31, 2026, and Mechanics Bank will retain roughly $13 million of runoff auto loans.
Westlake Portfolio Management will continue servicing the auto loans for both Bank of America and Mechanics Bank.
Management says the sale will help optimize the balance sheet, reduce risk, improve liquidity and enhance future profitability.
